answer: To cash out at an agent, you will need to generate a 6-digit cash-out code, which is valid for 15 minutes. Tell the agent the code and they will pay you in cash after their terminal shows success. Please note that the agent may not have sufficient float to pay you, in which case you can try another agent. The customer fee for cash-out is 1% of the cash-out amount, with a minimum fee of 5 KBR. For example, if you cash out 200 KBR, the fee will be 5 KBR, and if you cash out 2,000 KBR, the fee will be 20 KBR.
